meta.title: PetroApp Egypt | Fleet fuel management with NFC
meta.description: Save up to 20% of your fleet fuel budget. An NFC chip per vehicle, spending limits per driver, certified e-invoices and {stations}+ stations across every governorate in Egypt.

hero.eyebrow: {stations}+ stations in every governorate · Certified e-invoices

h1.A: Stop fuel waste in your fleet — and save up to {pct}% of your fuel budget
h1.B: Full control of your fleet's fuel spend from one platform

hero.sub: An NFC chip on every vehicle, spending limits for every driver, and no cash at the station. Every litre is logged against the vehicle and the driver.

pain.title: Is this happening in your fleet?

items.title: Fuel theft and padded receipts
items.body: Litres billed but never put in the tank, and receipts that don't match what was spent.

items.title: Cash advances that never reconcile
items.body: Money handed to drivers, and every month-end turns into a reconciliation exercise.

items.title: Fuel is pricier — and still under review
items.body: Prices rose about EGP 3/L in March 2026, and the pricing committee reviews them every quarter.

items.title: No report, no e-invoice
items.body: No per-vehicle consumption data, and no e-invoice you can use with the Tax Authority.

pain.closing: Every litre costs more now — and every litre that leaks costs more.

steps.body: A chip on every vehicle, installed in a few days.

steps.title: Drivers fuel cashless
steps.body: At any partner station; the transaction appears instantly in your dashboard with an e-invoice.

items.q: What is the minimum number of vehicles?
items.a: You can start with a single vehicle, and prices drop as your fleet grows.
{stations}+ multi-brand stations across every governorate in Egypt; the driver app shows the nearest partner station.

items.q: How does the NFC chip work — can drivers bypass it?
items.a: The chip is fitted at the vehicle's fuel inlet and fuelling only starts when the station nozzle reads it. It can't be used for another vehicle or beyond the limits you set.
[CONFIRM] Prepaid is available; postpaid options depend on fleet size and are agreed with sales.

items.q: How long does installation take, and what does it cost?
items.a: Installation takes about {days} working days, with a fixed per-vehicle installation fee [CONFIRM].
Yes. Invoices are aligned with the Egyptian Tax Authority system, so VAT and costs remain deductible.

items.q: Can it integrate with our ERP?
items.a: Yes. APIs and report exports are available for common accounting and ERP systems.
[CONFIRM] Monthly and yearly plans are available.

items.q: How do you protect our data?
items.a: We comply with Egypt's Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020, and your data is only used for the purpose you provided it for.

items.q: What happens after I submit the form?
items.a: We'll call you within 15 minutes during working hours, understand your fleet's needs and send you a quote.
